contract_question: Can we add a compiled Route1CriticalTailVisibilityCover with individual channel charges/losses and visibility cover that constructs the existing Route1ChannelVisibilityProducer, without claiming the PDE visibility theorem is proved?
rationale_short: Useful if it is clearly a producer surface, not a proof of visibility. Main risk is smuggling no-invisible residual as a channel without an independent visibility field.
